title: Fall foliage railway park
description: Explore the marked moments. E interacts, and Q lets the other person lead.

interactions.label: The red railway car
interactions.title: The red railway car
interactions.text: Each press of E pedals the car forward. Four pedals to reach each scenic stop.

memory.label: We're on our way!
memory.caption: I think I remember asking to do this photoshoot here with you hahaha I love you
memory.alt: A dreamy time together at the railway park.

memory.label: Railway photoshoot
memory.caption: This photo shoot I remember was low key kinda awkward because it felt like everyone was watching us and I just couldn't be natural. Pooz cooked and there was a cute lil cat too!
memory.alt: A walk through the autumn colors.

memory.label: Another fall foliage date!
memory.caption: I feel like this was one of your favorite dates/group of photos of us. I mainly loved how excited you were and the little treats we had too. Also the weather cooling down from the summer heat was nice.

boardingMemory.label: Time to embark!
boardingMemory.caption: I'm glad we got to sit together in the front car just us and feel like it was just me and you. It was also kinda fun having everyone else behind us wondering if they were talking about us haha

checkpoint.title: Fall foliage railway park, remembered
checkpoint.text: One of the best chapters of our early relationship.
